title: Mishlove's eleven-year study of Ted Owens

tellings.quote: I worked with Owens for 11 years from 1976 to 1987 when he died. [laughter]

plain: A researcher of psychic abilities with a PhD, Jeffrey Mishlove, says he worked with Ted Owens, a man who claimed psychic powers, for eleven years, from 1976 until Owens died in 1987. Mishlove tells it first-hand, naming the physicists Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ, who studied psychic claims, and the archive on Owens he kept. The study was meant to test whether Owens's claimed powers were real.
